name: Webflow
summary: Visual website builder with CMS, hosting, localisation and SEO/AEO tools.
description: Webflow is a visual platform for designing, building and hosting websites without writing code. It includes a CMS, interactions, localisation, shared libraries, analytics, optimisation and SEO and answer-engine (AEO) features, and recently added Campaigns for marketing teams. Users can build on a webflow.io domain for free; the Basic site plan costs $15 per month billed yearly. Plans are split between site plans and workspace plans for teams, with enterprise options handled by sales.
